name: Race NYC
summary:
New York never sleeps. Neither do its highways.

THE MIDNIGHT LOOP
A 14 km night loop around Manhattan with four lanes each way: the East River Drive under the bridges, the Midtown Viaduct and its Neon Mile of glowing billboards, the Hudson Skyway high over the river, and down into the Battery Tunnel. Wet asphalt mirrors the skyline, the street lamps and the neon as you fly past.
